title: Portland Rose Society — Guide to Pruning Roses

common.preserved_uncertainty: Its tie-break is stated for crowded canes, a closely related case.

content.relevance: Says removed canes go entirely back to the bud union or major cane; usually leave the larger of a crowded pair.
